name: Frost Ferry
hint: On ice, a push is a promise: the crate goes until something stops it.
catch: one push along the ice row glides a crate straight onto the plate, but the only crate that can reach that row starts two rows away, and every push on ice overshoots. Ferry it — with the other crate moved aside first — onto the single tile that lines it up, then slide up the same ice to the gate.
